title: Service Credits and the Volume Rebate (Corporate Travel Programmes)
content:
Two credits on the Corporate Travel Programmes arise from the agency's own performance and from the company's own volume rather than from any correction to an invoice: the service credit when the desk misses its response target, and the volume rebate on a year's booking value.

## The service credit

Where the service desk misses the tier's response target, the tier's service credit is applied to the following period's subscription, and a tier with no service credit gives none.

The credit is a percentage of the monthly subscription, it attaches to the period after the one in which the target was missed, and on a tier whose published service credit is nil it is nil however the target was missed.

## The volume rebate

The volume rebate accrues on booking value above the tier's threshold in the contract year, at the tier's rebate percentage, and is credited once after the contract year closes rather than month by month.

The contract year runs from the contract start date. The booking value measured over it is the total of the amounts of the booking transaction fees raised on that programme within that year. The rebate accrues only on the part of that value that stands above the tier's threshold, and it accrues at the tier's rebate percentage.

## A rebate computed on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical company on the Business Enterprise Programme, whose rebate threshold is 1000000.00 and whose rebate rate is 1.0 per cent, and suppose its booking value for the closed contract year came to 1400000.00.

- Value above the threshold: 1400000.00 less 1000000.00 gives 400000.00.
- Rebate: 400000.00 multiplied by 1.0 per cent gives 4000.00.
- Timing: one credit after the contract year closes, not twelve monthly ones.

Had the same company's booking value for the year come to 900000.00, no part of it would stand above the threshold and the rebate would be nil.

## How the two credits differ

- The rebate is measured on the value above the threshold, never on the whole year's value.
- A tier whose published rebate rate is nil gives no rebate, whatever the year's booking value.
- The service credit and the volume rebate answer to different facts: one to a missed response target, the other to a year's booking value.
